resolution.question: The Marlin Bay harbor advisory committee needs five of its nine members present to act. Will it reach quorum at its rescheduled Tuesday evening meeting?
resolution.resolution: Resolve YES only if the persistent event history shows that at least five members (including the chair) are actually present at the rescheduled Tuesday evening meeting before the meeting's end. Otherwise resolve NO at the hard cutoff 2026-08-11T21:00:00-07:00.
